thought.text: Reading works but send returns 404. Let me check the exact send endpoint route:

reasoning_content:
Interesting — reading works with the encoded room ID, but sending returns 404 M_NOT_FOUND. Maybe the send event endpoint is different (e.g., the room needs to exist and the txn id path is correct). Let me check what the actual Matrix send endpoint is. The standard is `PUT /rooms/{roomId}/send/{eventType}/{txnId}`. Wait — is Nebu using PUT instead of POST? Let me check the HTTP public layer.

Actually, let me check the Matrix CS API send route in the codebase.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "send" server/lib/nebu/matrix/http_public.ex | grep -iE "def|route|put|post|/send" | head; echo ---; grep -rn '"/send\|:event_type.*txn\|txn_id' server/lib/nebu/matrix/http_public.ex | head
